purpose: New recovery production candidate, not recovered old r002 bytes; a small evidence-informed stylized fossil specimen for close museum browsing.

claim_scope.representation: Preserved damaged shell only; no animal soft anatomy; not scientifically exact reconstruction.
claim_scope.era: Silurian, Ludlow, Ludfordian; upper S. linearis Zone
claim_scope.locality: Velký vrch Hill at Koněprusy, Prague Basin, Bohemia
claim_scope.planning_inventory: Original stable ID and genus-level target retained; historical inventory remains unchanged and is not scientific specimen evidence.

coverage_justification: Static-stylized eight-fixed-view baseline retained, with extra hero/reverse/clayalt and aperture detail; no exemption for scientific, independent, GPU or composed-scene gates.

geometry_policy.self_intersections: Complete strict all-candidate-pairs audit required; sampling prohibited; original implementation currently unavailable so gate UNKNOWN until restored or explicitly substituted with documented equivalent.

style: Refined low-poly, quiet warm limestone palette, broad planes, minimal growth relief; no copied texture.

overrides: Do not copy deep open cave, excessive texture, or long tail.
Source lateral envelope and preserved damage govern shape.
Place mouth on dorsal expanded flank facing +Y and partly -Z, NOT a +Z open bowl and NOT the concept front-chest cave.

structure.primary: Short expanded laterally compressed body chamber, upper end curves into a modest contracted hood rather than a flat mechanical cut.
structure.secondary: Short bent tapered apical remnant with missing extreme apex
structure.tertiary: Shallow continuous U-shaped contracted recess on dorsal expanded flank, with coupled dorsal lobes; separate short damaged narrow hyponomic rim.

scale.method: Original parametric profile placed in the approximately four-centimeter specimen class; source measurements supply magnitude not exact world-axis constraints.
scale.source_measurement_uncertainty: Published measurement axes and paths unspecified in consulted passage; no independent bar in Fig8 ×0.7. Do not pixel-calibrate or claim exact dimension equality.
scale.diagnostic_ratio: Text says dorsoventral/lateral about 1.5; compare broad compression qualitatively and stated local construction ratio, not exact bbox.

axes.blender: X lateral, -Y ventral/concave bend, +Z toward broad end; aperture is separately dorsal +Y and downward -Z.
axes.origin: Center of minimum support plane; not claimed living posture

uncertainties: Hidden cavity depth and matrix preservation not resolved from photographs. Shallow bounded relief is original interpretive geometry, not a recovered measurement.
Apertural direction and two dorsal lobes are text-supported; exact contour is not uniquely readable at original image resolution.
Color is artistic, not recovered biological or fossil chemical color.

criteria.description: Exact-export static and official validation, complete source reexport, two independent full deterministic rebuilds, strict exhaustive intersections, outward watertight finite nondegenerate mesh; configured budgets.
Fresh independent actual-pixel review of all eight exact-GLB views plus details for silhouette, aperture, damage, planes and coherence.
Check damaged SM75 scope, compressed cyrtocone, no restored apex/tube, continuous U and paired dorsal lobes; maintain uncertainty.
Verify frozen seven roles, all helper content hashes, source scale semantics and zero textures; maker self-test is not independent acceptance.
Exact final GLB loaded by Three0.180.0 GLTFLoader and bounds/materials checked.
Actual GPU rendering separate from parse; remains UNKNOWN if not run.
Actual populated-scene rendering and measured work; remains UNKNOWN if not run.

pregeometry_source_direction_review.basis: Parent inspected Fig8 original four views and p127 description/caption.
pregeometry_source_direction_review.constraints: dorsally placed, downward oriented; keep filled/preserved shallow interpretation and do not invent precise angle or deep cavity.

repair_from_c001: Cubic Hermite centerline/profile removes observed abrupt fold steps.
Upper contracted envelope replaces mechanically planar cap, retaining damage and a shallow dorsal/downward U recess.
Recess uses lighter sediment hue; it is not a black painted symbol or recovered cavity depth.

repair_from_c002_F01.scope: Only the local narrow hyponomic remnant and smallest necessary adjacent crest to interrupt the intact rectangular perimeter. All shell control points, loft, dorsal U, apex, palette, unit/measurement semantics and source constraints remain unchanged.
repair_from_c002_F01.uncertainty: New ragged contour and shallow abrasion are explicitly interpretive; source does not resolve their exact shape. No complete opening or tube is restored.
repair_from_c002_F01.evidence_required: fresh exactGLB front, hero, top, sides and all canonical views; full technical checks and independent difference review
